newsitem.title: ESTONIA: TALLINNA RAISES SYNDICATED LOAN SUM.
newsitem.headline: TALLINNA RAISES SYNDICATED LOAN SUM.

text.p: Tallinna Pank said on Thursday it will increase its syndicated loan by 20 million German marks to 50 million German marks.
"The bank decided to increase the sum because it grows so fast and based on loan portfolio growth we find it an optimum sum," Guido Klaas, the bank's corporate finance head, told Reuters.
The bank's syndicated loan subscription, closed on Wednesday, was oversubsribed by almost two times, Klaas said.
The interest rate is LIBOR plus a marginal of 1.375 percent.
"The interest rate is considerably more favourable than our previous credits from international investors," Klaas said.
The bank decided to refinance some of its old loans from the new source, he added.
Twenty commercial banks from around the world participated in the syndicate, Klaas said.
